Proposition
[Signature drop on the kernel of a functional]

↗ def:bilinear-gradient ↗ lem:bilinear-gradient-orthogonal-ker ↗ prop:hypersurface-signature-pointwise-hyperplane

Let $B$ on $V$ have signature $(r,s)$ and let $0\ne a\in V^*$. If $B(a^\sharp ,a^\sharp )>0$, then $B|_{\ker a}$ has signature $(r-1,s)$; if it is negative, the signature is $(r,s-1)$. This is the fibrewise form of Corollary 17.
Proof

↗ def:bilinear-gradient ↗ lem:bilinear-gradient-orthogonal-ker ↗ prop:hypersurface-signature-pointwise-hyperplane \sketch Rank–nullity makes $\ker a$ a hyperplane. Lemma 17 puts the nonzero $a^\sharp $ in its complement, so Proposition 17 applies.

□
